sections.label: Nose
Eyes
sections.text:
Opacity of cornea. Blue circle around eyes.
One pupil dilated. Night blindness.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Distortion of mouth. Trembling of jaw.
Facial paralysis; more left side.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Difficult swallowing. Qisophagus con-
stricted. [Bapt.] Salty belching. Intense nausea, with
pain and cold. Stringy, offensive exudation on mucous
membrane. Salty taste.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Sore throat, constant tickling ; gagging and
nausea, worse deep breathing ; chilliness and aching.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Soreness in pit of stomach on pressure.
Violent nausea; retching. Black vomit. Vomiting of
ipucus,.. green slime, blood, with great prostration, and
fend crness over the stomach. Burning and cut-
ting pains in stomach. Carcinoma, helps the persistent
Vomitiiig. Coffee ground vomiting.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Sore, tender, tympanitic. Region of liver


161

sore. Coldness. Black, offensive clots of blood from
bowels. Pain in abdomen, with vomiting. Tenderness
and tympanites.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Gelatinous stools. Bloody, black, and of-
fensive. Gelatinous, yellowish green; semi-fluid, with
urinary suppression.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Rawness and soreness in urethra, urine
mixed with pus and blood.

Heart — Palpitation, with constriction of chest.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Icy coldness. [Catnph.; Verat.; Heloderm.]
Yellow fever. [Crotalus; Carho.]

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Blue, yellow, sallow, scaly, cracking. Itch-
ing; better scratching. Chloasma, yellowish stains on
nose and cheeks ; worse exposure to sun and wind.
Chilblains.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Stops breathing on going to sleep. Wakes
up suffocating. Fears to go to sleep again. Protracted
sleeplessness.

sections.label: Modalities
Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Cadmium oxide; Cad.
brom. (pain and burning in stomach, and vomiting) ;
Cadmium jodat. (Itching of anus and rectum felt dur-
ing the day only; constipation, frequent desire, tenes-
mus, abdomen bloated) ; Zinc., Ars.; Carbo; Verat.
